gates.evidence: Surface s04 is the standard Janitor Plus subscription paywall, which is SFW and age-appropriate.
Rewards a 1-hour trial of Janitor Plus features upon completing a 15-second game; no clicks/installs/cash.
Offer uses clean copy 'Try Janitor Plus Free' with explicit decline 'No Thanks'.
User taps 'Play Now' CTA after viewing the prompt.
Body text states: 'Play a quick 15-second game to unlock 1 hour of premium memory.'
Includes 'No Thanks' button which returns the user without penalty.
Triggered upon dismissing the paywall (s04), not during active chat streaming.
Eligibility is explicitly restricted to 'Non-paying free users who dismiss the subscription paywall'.

scores.evidence: The user just hit the paywall (m3, s04) expressing interest in Janitor Plus features. Offering a 1-hour trial right at paywall dismissal (TAX-10 fallback) perfectly matches the moment of desire.
Appends a trial offer to the paywall dismissal (ne1 on s04), preserving the user's journey and adding additive sampling value without taking away free features.
Strictly gated to non-payers who decline the paywall (m3), time-boxed to just 1 hour, capped at once per day, and backed by a 20% holdout with non-inferiority guardrails.
Code computes cost to serve per view as $0.0018, which is well below the US net revenue per view ($0.0090–$0.0150).
Paywall views (m3) occur whenever free users encounter upgrade prompts or limits, reaching a substantial share of engaged free users daily.
Uses standard SIM-RWD unit with invitation entry point and standard REWARD_VERIFIED callback, mapping cleanly to existing Simula SDK capabilities.
Targets screen s04 ('Janitor Plus Paywall'), references Janitor Plus entitlement (of1), and uses app-specific context (premium memory, priority routing).
Capped at once per day (perDay: 1, cooldownMin: 1440), preventing nagging.
Specifies primary metrics, guardrails (3% non-inferiority, retention), and a 20% user-level randomized holdout for 28 days.

parsed.topConcern: None; proposal is exceptionally well-structured, targeting paywall decliners with tight time-boxing and robust holdout testing.
